## Before the workshop

You need R (≥ 4.1) and the speed package:

```r
install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("biometryhub/speed")
```

Check that it works:

```r
library(speed)
d <- initialise_design_df(items = 4, nrows = 4, ncols = 4)
autoplot(speed(d, swap = "treatment", seed = 1))
```
